predict.question: B contains 10 winners plus 90 other firms, whose toy winner rate is zero. What is B’s toy result?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: Good to Great searches for distinguishing patterns in selected companies with unusually strong prior performance.
modelBoundary: A reports {A}%; B reports {B}%. Adding 90 omitted non-winners changes the denominator from 10 to 100 without changing any firm’s result. These are invented groups; neither a causal explanation nor a replication of the book is supplied.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? The arithmetic follows our assumptions; real-world applicability and book attribution remain unverified.
